governing_intent: Prove an event-driven, offline continuous factory loop with deterministic doubles, durable restart recovery, and enforced local-artifact custody before any vendor adapter or real worker exists.
summary: The contract is bounded, sequenced after PY-03, and supplies enough authority to implement without inventing Founder or architecture decisions. Its acceptance criteria require executable end-to-end proof rather than coordinator-internal mocks.
implementation_unknowns: Concrete port signatures and fixture schema for WorkManagement, WorkerProvider, candidate store, and verifier observations.
Local content-addressed artifact layout and retention-policy adapter mechanics.
Exact subprocess harness and deterministic check used to prove fresh-process retrieval and real restart.
Selection of existing Python and Node test commands from repository tooling.
verification_assessment: Strong: it requires deterministic real-loop tests, a real process restart on SQLite, separate-process digest read-back before VERIFY, negative custody and evidence tests, ordering/WIP/no-polling assertions, retained run evidence, fitness checks, and the Node suite. The coordinator itself may not be mocked.
material_risks: PY-03 acceptance remains a sequencing prerequisite and must be reverified at release.
The Satisfies table should eventually add SF-REQ-007 as a bounded contributing extent for the SWF-12 local-artifact proof; PY-06 remains primary for production custody.
The actual checkout contains unrelated untracked documentation, so implementation must establish and record its clean released baseline before edits.
next_action: After PY-03 is accepted, create or advance PY-04 to READY using the released clean-main baseline and retain the SF-REQ-007 traceability correction as a non-authority contract hygiene item.
rationale: Founder decisions fix release policy, ownership, budgets, offline scripted-worker limits, and local-artifact custody; the approved architecture constrains event-driven coordination, reservation/WIP behavior, lifecycle, and adapter boundaries. Remaining choices are ordinary implementation details, not owner decisions, and the single coordinator loop is one coherent execution vertical rather than multiple independent decision centers.

provider_evidence.note: reassessment at PY-03-landed baseline after closure-policy normalization
